revenue_scope: Worldwide (US + Intl) 'OTHER' line of J&J's Cardiovascular / Metabolism / Other franchise (the franchise's residual line after XARELTO), which holds INVOKANA from 2023Q1 and PROCRIT / EPREX from 2022Q1.
why_separate: J&J stopped printing INVOKANA / INVOKAMET on its own line after 2022Q4 ('Other is inclusive of INVOKANA, which was previously disclosed separately'); the continuation is the franchise's residual OTHER line, which also holds PROCRIT / EPREX and other products. It is a broader line, not Invokana's own sales.
notes: Span 2023Q1-2026Q2. Composition of the line: footnote (3) of the 2022Q1 schedule says 'Other is inclusive of PROCRIT / EPREX, which was previously disclosed separately', and footnote (3) of the 2023Q1 schedule says 'Other is inclusive of INVOKANA, which was previously disclosed separately'. J&J printed INVOKANA / INVOKAMET on its own line through 2022Q4, so the 2022 'Other' rows (first printed 274, 243, 236, 213) include PROCRIT / EPREX but not INVOKANA, while the 2023Q1 schedule restates 2022 'Other' to 402, 363, 345, 304 (for 2022Q4 213 + INVOKANA / INVOKAMET 91 = 304). Each quarter is recorded as first printed, so the line steps up at 2023Q1 by the INVOKANA amount. The same OTHER rows are the continuation of the Procrit series (jnj_procrit_cont), which starts a year earlier. The franchise is printed as 'CARDIOVASCULAR / METABOLISM / OTHER' and from 2026Q1 as 'CARDIOVASCULAR / METABOLISM / OTHER (CVM)'; the 'OTHER' row recorded is the one under that franchise (not 'OTHER CARDIOVASCULAR', a MedTech line). Annual checks: each Q4 schedule's twelve-month figure equals the sum of that year's four rows (2023 1,306, 2024 1,189, 2025 1,145). Other products in the line are not named by J&J. Mitsubishi Tanabe markets canagliflozin in Japan under a different brand (Canaglu), a different label and territory, and was not used.
